title: Check RMS Map Monitor Emergency Stop Trigger and Emergency Stop Button State
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor (robotControl) view to confirm whether the UI shows the 'Emergency stop trigger' section and the 'Emergency stop button' control for the current robot/fleet view.
when_to_use: When support needs to verify whether the RMS Map Monitor (robotControl) page is presenting the emergency-stop-trigger-related UI elements ('Emergency stop trigger' and 'Emergency stop button') for the current view.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open RMS / fleet status UI and verify the presence/visibility of the 'Emergency stop trigger' section and the 'Emergency stop button' control on the Map Monitor (robotControl) page.
safety_notes: Do not perform physical E-stop actions from this procedure; this runbook only verifies UI element presence/visibility on RMS.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) web access

system_preconditions: RMS Map Monitor (robotControl) page is reachable and loads in the browser.

visual_references.description: RMS Map Monitor (robotControl) frame showing the 'Emergency stop trigger' text/section and the 'Emergency stop button' control.

steps.title: Open RMS Map Monitor (robotControl) view
steps.purpose: Get to the RMS Map Monitor page where the emergency stop trigger and button state are shown.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), navigate to the Map Monitor / robotControl view. The captured frame indicates the URL pattern: /static/rms/#/monitor/robotControl.
steps.expected_result: The RMS Map Monitor / robotControl page loads and displays the Map Monitor UI.
steps.healthy_condition: The Map Monitor / robotControl page is visible (page content renders) so that the 'Emergency stop trigger' and 'Emergency stop button' areas can be checked.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS Map Monitor page does not load, or the page content is not readable/visible.

actions.label: Navigate to robotControl Map Monitor
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the Map Monitor / robotControl view (URL pattern shown in the captured frame: /static/rms/#/monitor/robotControl).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the RMS Map Monitor page does not load, escalate to deeper RMS/WCS/API checks (or site support) to determine whether the UI is unreachable or the system is not publishing the expected state.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/captured frame includes RMS map monitoring page URL pattern /static/rms/#/monitor/robotControl and shows emergency stop trigger/button UI elements.

steps.title: Verify 'Emergency stop trigger' section is present and what it shows
steps.purpose: Confirm whether the RMS UI is presenting the emergency stop trigger indicator/text for the current view.
steps.instruction: On the RMS Map Monitor / robotControl page, locate the UI section labeled 'Emergency stop trigger' and confirm what is currently displayed (present/active vs missing/unreadable).
steps.expected_result: The RMS Map Monitor / robotControl page displays the 'Emergency stop trigger' section.
steps.healthy_condition: The 'Emergency stop trigger' label/section is visible on the page for the current robot/fleet view.
steps.failure_condition: The 'Emergency stop trigger' section is missing or cannot be read/verified on the page.

actions.label: Check Emergency stop trigger section
actions.exact_action: Locate the UI section labeled 'Emergency stop trigger' and confirm what is currently displayed (e.g., whether the trigger indicator/text is present/active).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the emergency stop trigger element is missing/unreadable, escalate to deeper RMS/WCS/API checks (or site support) to determine whether the UI is unreachable or the system is not publishing the expected state.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR text includes 'Emergency stop trigger' on the RMS map monitoring page.

steps.title: Verify 'Emergency stop button' control state/visibility
steps.purpose: Confirm whether the RMS UI is presenting the emergency stop button control for the current view.
steps.instruction: On the RMS Map Monitor / robotControl page, locate the 'Emergency stop button' control and confirm its current state/visibility (e.g., whether the button is shown/enabled as displayed on the page).
steps.expected_result: The RMS Map Monitor / robotControl page displays the 'Emergency stop button' control.
steps.healthy_condition: The 'Emergency stop button' control area is visible on the page for the current robot/fleet view.
steps.failure_condition: The 'Emergency stop button' control is missing or cannot be verified on the page.

actions.label: Check Emergency stop button control
actions.exact_action: Locate the 'Emergency stop button' control and confirm its current state/visibility (e.g., whether the button is shown/enabled as displayed on the page).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the emergency stop button element is missing/unreadable, escalate to deeper RMS/WCS/API checks (or site support) to determine whether the UI is unreachable or the system is not publishing the expected state.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR text includes 'Emergency stop button' on the RMS map monitoring page.

steps.title: Record observed UI state for escalation/next diagnostics
steps.purpose: Capture what the UI is showing so the next diagnostic path can be chosen.
steps.instruction: If the RMS page shows both the 'Emergency stop trigger' section and the 'Emergency stop button' area, record the observed UI state (presence/visibility and what is displayed) for escalation/next diagnostics.
steps.expected_result: You have a recorded observation that both emergency-stop-related UI elements are present/visible (or you have recorded that one/both are missing/unreadable).
steps.healthy_condition: Both UI elements ('Emergency stop trigger' and 'Emergency stop button') are visible and can be described/recorded for the current view.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reliably determine the UI state because elements are missing/unreadable.

actions.label: Record UI observation
actions.exact_action: If the RMS page shows the emergency stop trigger and the Emergency stop button area is visible, record the observed UI state for escalation/next diagnostics.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the RMS page does not load or the emergency stop trigger/button elements are missing/unreadable, escalate to deeper RMS/WCS/API checks (or site support) to determine whether the UI is unreachable or the system is not publishing the expected state.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate notes indicate recording observed UI state when both elements are visible; OCR evidence shows both elements exist on the captured RMS map monitoring page frame.

RMS Map Monitor / robotControl page displays the 'Emergency stop button' control.
healthy_conditions: On RMS Map Monitor / robotControl, the 'Emergency stop trigger' label/section is visible.
On RMS Map Monitor / robotControl, the 'Emergency stop button' control area is visible.
failure_conditions: RMS Map Monitor / robotControl page does not load.
The 'Emergency stop trigger' section is missing or unreadable.
The 'Emergency stop button' control is missing or unreadable.
escalation_guidance: If the RMS Map Monitor page does not load or the emergency stop trigger/button elements are missing/unreadable, escalate to deeper RMS/WCS/API checks (or site support) to determine whether the UI is unreachable or the system is not publishing the expected state.
